title: InFactPlanner: Planning Sustainable Geo-Distributed LLM Data Centers
abstract: arXiv:2608.12915v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid growth of LLM inference is shifting sustainability concerns from one-time training to continuous serving, where infrastructure decisions shape energy use, carbon emissions, water consumption, and service quality. Yet operators often need to compare deployment alternatives before large-scale infrastructure is built, making direct measurement costly, slow, and sometimes infeasible. We present InFactPlanner, a trace-driven decision-support framework for what-if analysis of sustainable AI data center deployment for LLM inference across single and geo-distributed sites. InFactPlanner combines query traces, hardware-model profiles, candidate site configurations, PUE/WUE parameters, renewable generation models, and time-varying grid carbon intensity to estimate power, energy, carbon emissions, water use, latency, and server utilization. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12915v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大语言模型推理的快速增长正在将可持续性关注点从一次性训练转向持续服务，其中基础设施决策影响能源使用、碳排放、水消耗和服务质量。然而，运营商通常需要在大型基础设施建成之前比较部署方案，这使得直接测量成本高昂、速度缓慢，有时甚至不可行。我们提出了InFactPlanner，一个基于轨迹的决策支持框架，用于对单个和地理分布式站点的大语言模型推理进行可持续AI数据中心部署的假设分析。InFactPlanner结合查询轨迹、硬件模型配置文件、候选站点配置、PUE/WUE参数、可再生能源模型和时变电网碳强度，来估算功率、能源、碳排放、水使用、延迟和服务器利用率。该框架将低层服务效应抽象为可配置的硬件模型配置文件，从而实现...
tldr: InFactPlanner是一个基于轨迹的决策支持框架，用于在建设前对地理分布式大语言模型数据中心进行可持续性假设分析，通过结合多种数据源估算能源、碳、水和性能指标。
en_tdlr: InFactPlanner is a trace-driven decision-support framework for pre-deployment what-if analysis of sustainable geo-distributed LLM data centers, estimating power, carbon, water, and performance metrics by integrating diverse data sources.
